page_title: RMA 0-0 RAY | Real Madrid v Rayo Vallecano 05/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+7' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+7' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) will miss the next game.
90+6' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is booked by the referee.
90+5' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:0.
90+1' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+1' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
88' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' Francisco prepares a substitution. Isi Palazon is replaced by Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano).
85' Here comes a substitution. Eduardo Camavinga is given a rest as he is replaced by Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid).
85' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
85' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
81' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) sends a long ball forward to Vinicius Junior, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
80' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) brought his opponent down.
78' Great teamplay by Real Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
75' Here is a change. Raul de Tomas is going off and Francisco gives the last tactical orders to Radamel Falcao (Rayo Vallecano).
75' The manager makes a subsitution with Bebe (Rayo Vallecano) coming on for Alvaro Garcia.
74' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
72' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
72' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Fran Garcia and he is replaced by Toni Kroos (Real Madrid).
72' So close! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
69' Substitution. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) on for Luka Modric.
66' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
63' Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
63' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
62' Looks like Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
60' Francisco decides to make a substitution. Pathe Ciss will be replaced by Kike Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Unai Lopez departs the field of play to be replaced by Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano).
58' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.

57' Close! David Alaba (Real Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
55' Joselu (Real Madrid) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
54' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).
51' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
50' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
47' Stole Dimitrievski (Rayo Vallecano) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' Real Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
42' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
39' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

39' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Joselu (Real Madrid) inside the box. He lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Stole Dimitrievski was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. Real Madrid win a corner.
37' Real Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
36' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
36' Joselu (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

33' David Alaba (Real Madrid) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
31' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.
30' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
26' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner.
25' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort. Good work from Real Madrid as they win a corner.
24' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick.
24' The Rayo Vallecano players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
21' Abdul Mumin (Rayo Vallecano) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stole Dimitrievski intercepts the ball.
19' Ball possession – 61:39.
18' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

15' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
14' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' Raul de Tomas (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside!
12' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
10' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) picks up an injury.
7' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
6' The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
6' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
4' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
